generationInputs.prompt: A softly glowing, centrally positioned close-up of the tarot card with the Roman numeral XIX and the Spanish text "EL SOL" is sharply in focus against a blurred, darker background featuring faint, luminous geometric shapes and silhouettes. The card, at the base of a three-card pyramid, depicts two children standing under a radiant sun with 16 rays, rendered in bold flat deep to light blue colors and thick black outlines, consistent with the monochromatic palette. Behind the card, translucent holographic scenes appear as diffused, less intense light sources: children playing, animated roots growing downward, and misty silhouettes evoking forgotten memories, all in shades of deep to light blue. The lighting is dim, atmospheric, bluish, and introspective, with the central tarot card emitting a noticeable glow that highlights its details. The overall rendering suggests a photographic approach with a shallow depth of field.
